title: Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒) Vol. 55 – Chinese Edition – Tong Li Comics
categoryName: Collectibles:Comic Books & Memorabilia:Manga & Asian Comics:Single Volumes
descriptionText:
Condition: Very Good – minimal shelf wear, tight binding, no missing pages. Slight aging on edges (see photos).
Language: Traditional Chinese
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Publishing Co., Ltd.)
Series: 正式授權中文版少年系列 (Official Licensed Chinese Shōnen Edition)
ISBN: 957-34-3671-X
Price on cover: NT$75 / HK$28
Description
This is Volume 55 of the long-running martial arts comedy manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也).
Published by Tong Li Comics in Taiwan, this officially licensed Traditional Chinese edition captures the humor, energy, and action of the original Japanese serialization.
This volume features an illustrated author photo and bonus commentary page inside (see pictures).
